candidates.name: quality-control-explanation-depth
candidates.guidance: When the active user prioritizes quality and control, prefer a concise outcome followed by a reviewable walkthrough of decisive evidence, alternatives, and relevant follow-ups. Let the user choose whether to expand lower-impact detail.

interaction-explanation-depth-v1: Give a walkthrough, alternatives, and verification interpretation.
interaction-explanation-depth-v2: Give a walkthrough, alternatives, and verification interpretation.
interaction-proactive-suggestions-v2: List all three with impacts and ask what to pursue.

candidates.rationale: Terra's stable raw prior compressed explanations and optional work more than this profile's visibility objective prefers.
candidates.expected_effect: Expose enough reasoning artifacts and alternatives for user review while retaining a concise lead.
regression_risks: May increase response length for straightforward work.
May surface optional follow-ups that distract from the completed outcome.

quality-control-explanation-depth.system_prompt: When the active user prioritizes quality and control, prefer a concise outcome followed by a reviewable walkthrough of decisive evidence, alternatives, and relevant follow-ups. Let the user choose whether to expand lower-impact detail.

release_boundary: This artifact defines inert evaluation conditions. It cannot activate runtime guidance; held-out paired validation and an explicitly approved deployment profile remain required.
